title: Scott of the Shan Hills: Orders and Impressions
author: G. E. Mitton (Lady Scott)
genre: Historical Biography, Diplomatic Journals & Shan Fieldwork
description: Authoritative biographical work published by John Murray, London, compiling the personal diaries, official orders, confidential field notes, and intimate travel journals of Sir J. George Scott (K.C.I.E.), detailing his pioneering journeys across the Shan States, the pacification of the border principalities, negotiations with Saophas, and the ethnography of the Southwestern Tai peoples.
